_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_status: SESSION 66 (Skylander) — pivoted into the TMC Builder lane (Sam's direction) to build a Chancellor's-Office ADT review tool that replaces the painful manual PDF-vs-PDF course-by-course diffing CO staff do today. Shipped 3 PRs: (1) split the COCI program status into ✓ Active (live in the catalog) vs ✓ Approved (pending activation) — 2,867 active / 218 pending across 40 TMCs, previously invisible; (2) the scope + the ASCCC acceptance ruleset distilled (the CO program-approval checklist + the tiered C-ID / flexible-with-ASSIST / faculty-review acceptance ladder), with the data joins validated on 4 colleges; (3) the acceptance metadata on the 45 TMC templates — 119 'flexible' slots flagged, a per-TMC fixed/flexible classification, 15 embedded C-IDs recovered (African American Studies fixed). NEXT (Sam: 'Go for A'): build the acceptance engine — per-slot ✓ accept / ⚠ ASSIST-evidence / needs-review + a 'ready / N issues' summary. docs/session_67_handoff.md.

items.text: Pick your college on the TMC Builder tab — every TMC shows whether you already have that ADT, now split into ✓ Active (live in your catalog) vs ✓ Approved (CO-approved, pending activation) + ⏳ In progress / ◐ Teach-out. We're building this into a Chancellor's-Office REVIEW tool: it will check a college's courses against each TMC's C-ID requirements automatically (replacing the manual PDF-vs-PDF diff). Spot-check your college's badges and flag anything off.

To populate every approved ADT with its REAL course list, we need the MIS Data Mart 'Program Course File' for all ~115 colleges. Fable will hand you a Playwright script that drives your browser through every college (select → View Report → Export) unattended in ~10–15 min — run it once on your machine (it reaches datamart.cccco.edu; the agent sandbox can't), then upload the folder of CSVs. No rush — the review engine is being built first and needs nothing from you.

(Standing, paused for the TMC push.) The CPL Assistant works again — try it. The green-lit next step is grounding its recommendations in our CCR/CER data + a per-college demand signal on the CPL Landing Sites. Three decisions unblock it: (1) the MAP Student Portal's own bot — same backend or separate, and can Fable see/call it? (2) how a per-college 'student demand' panel embeds in the Landing Site; (3) which MAP Custom Reports fields are public-safe vs coordinator-only. Plan: the CCR/CER scope doc.

The Knowledge Base tab is LIVE — sign in with your magic link and try the ✍️ New doc composer: write/paste notes, attach a file (text, PDF, Word, Excel, or a screenshot), ✨ Polish with Claude, then 'Open in GitHub →' to commit it as yourself. Please smoke-test ALL FIVE attachment types and flag any red error chip. One decision: keep the knowledge-base repo's copy of the portal in sync too, or treat the dashboard copy as canonical?

First Light's anonymous reflections can become a gentle weekly 'musings' digest for our private Obsidian vault (never the public site). It's READY; it just needs the service key on the cpl-knowledge-base repo. One-time step: add an Actions secret named SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY (the same Supabase service-role key the dashboard's daily sync uses) to cpl-knowledge-base.

✨ Suggested merges (data lane, still live): groups by the obvious keyword (Algebra, the languages, ESL, Ballet, ECE/EMT/CNA/HVAC/LVN) — divider words AND abbreviations fold. Confirm the obvious families; UNCHECK or Skip a genuine progression (units are the tell). Popup tools: '➕ Add more courses by keyword', the 🏷 'match strength' slider, title-cleanup on a different target, and a 'Completion note' box.

395 college course titles carry encoding garbage at the source. The dashboard shows them repaired with a '⚠ fix in COCI' chip; the campaign list is kb/coci_title_corrections.json — take it to the colleges when ready.

PRIORITY (Sam: 'Go for A'): build the Phase-2 ACCEPTANCE ENGINE in tmc_builder.js — per-slot verdict from the ASCCC rules (C-ID match = ✓ mandatory accept · slot.flexible = ⚠ accept-with-ASSIST · specific C-ID filled by a non-match = faculty review · unfilled = ○ needs a course) + the structural checklist (major ≥18 sem · ≤60 · select-counts · no local add-ons) + a 'Ready / N issues' banner. Extend statusFor(); consume slot.flexible + t.flexibility (#479). No new data — demo on Allan Hancock (rich C-ID) vs San Diego City (zero). Commit a jsdom test. Scope: docs/kb-notes/tmc-co-review-scope.md; rules: reference-adt-acceptance-rules.md.

Write the Playwright bulk-PCF extractor for Sam to run (DevExpress College_MCF.aspx: per college select → View Report → Export CSV; self-discover the dropdown; college code in ASPxComboBoxC_VI). Then tmc/_build_college_adt_courses.py joins PCF→COCI course list → tmc_college_adt_courses.js (per college,ADT → real member courses + C-ID/units) = the Phase-1 current-state bootstrap. Also the older TMC follow-ups: harden kb/college_short_names.json with the PROGRAM_COLLEGE_ALIASES; ADT-overlay refresh on a fresh extract; a C-ID-discrepancy export; faculty-verify the 45 drafts.

(Standing, paused for the TMC push.) The CPL-Assistant CCR/CER recommender per docs/kb-notes/cpl-assistant-ccr-cer-recommendation-scope.md. START with the ETL — land a slim CCR + CER + adoption dataset into SHARED Supabase via the daily cron (no live bot change). Then M1 wires it into cpl-chat (careful redeploy of the SHARED function — capture version, verify_jwt:false, smoke 4 modes). M3 = the demand stamp (privacy ADR first). M2 (benchmark) blocked on portal-bot access.

CCR data passes (queued, measure-first, own dry-run PRs): (1) the morphological-variant pass — Medical Assisting vs Assistant, the -ing/-ant/-ology family (lemmatize/stem the title token before _sug_sig, or a stem-pair map); MEASURE regroup + over-merge first.
